description: The line plot illustrates the Micro F1 (%) performance of KnowPrompt across four datasets—TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED, and SemEval—when trained with varying numbers of training samples generated by large language models. The x-axis, labeled "Number of Samples Generated," displays four discrete values: K=8, K=16, K=32, and K=64, representing the number of generated samples. The y-axis, labeled "Micro F1 (%)", ranges from 20 to 50, with gridlines at intervals of 5. Four distinct lines, each with a unique color and marker, represent the datasets: TACRED (blue, circle), TACRED-Revisit (orange, triangle), Re-TACRED (green, diamond), and SemEval (red, square). The TACRED line starts at approximately 23% at K=8 and increases to about 29% at K=64. The TACRED-Revisit line begins at around 23% and rises to approximately 30% at K=64, showing a similar trend to TACRED but consistently higher. The Re-TACRED line starts at 35% and steadily increases, reaching a peak of 51% at K=64. The SemEval line begins at 42% and increases to 52% at K=64, showing a slower but consistent improvement. The legend in the top-left corner identifies each dataset with its corresponding line style and marker.
caption_used: Micro F1 (%) of KnowPrompt using different numbers of training samples generated by LLMs. The line plot shows the performance of four datasets: TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED, and SemEval. The x-axis represents the number of samples generated (K=8, K=16, K=32, K=64), while the y-axis shows Micro F1 (%) ranging from 20 to 50. TACRED and TACRED-Revisit exhibit similar trends, with TACRED-Revisit consistently outperforming TACRED by approximately 5% across all sample sizes. Re-TACRED demonstrates a steady increase, peaking at 51% at K=64, while SemEval shows a slower rate of improvement, reaching 47% at K=64. The legend in the top left corner maps each dataset to its corresponding line style and marker.
